en: Black‑and‑white view of a cloister garden with dense vegetation and a central tree, stone steps leading to a doorway on the left, and a robed Franciscan friar standing on the steps. In the background to the right rises a white stucco bell tower or dome with arched openings and a cross on top, typical of Spanish‑mission church architecture. The overall style and composition resemble an old photographic postcard.
